facts.business: Oswal Greentech Limited is primarily engaged in real estate development and construction activities, along with investment of surplus funds including inter-corporate deposits.

guidance_or_targets.statement: The Company expects to conclude sales of the flagship residential project at Ludhiana in the near term and is confident that the remaining flats will be absorbed swiftly.
guidance_or_targets.value: 513 of 538 flats sold as on 31st March 2026

auditor.name: M/s. BGMG & Associates, Chartered Accountants
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion due to: (A) Arbitration Award - interest income and current assets understated by Rs 4,249.10 lakh and Rs 11,754.57 lakh respectively; arbitration award of Rs 9,717.00 lakh against claim of Rs 47,212.27 lakh challenged in High Court. (B) Non-conformity & uncertainty of ICD and Real-Estate Advances aggregating Rs 1,22,676.83 lakh outstanding as of March 31, 2026, subject to confirmation, recoverability not determinable. Emphasis of Matter: (A) Provisioning of ICD (Rs 7,422.19 lakh) and real estate advance (Rs 2,700 lakh) to Uppal Chadha Hi-Tech Developers and SAS Servizio, reduced to nil. (B) Fraud by employee involving leasehold land at Rishra, West Bengal, conveyance terminated as null and void.

key_risks: Arbitration award partially in favor, challenged in High Court leading to understatement of interest income and current assets
ICDs and real estate advances aggregating Rs 1,22,676.83 lakh outstanding, subject to confirmation, recoverability uncertain
Significant credit risk concentration in loans (ICDs) and interest receivable aggregating Rs 65,778.61 lakh (49.13% of total financial assets)
Fraud by employee involving leasehold land at Rishra, West Bengal, unauthorized trespass and conveyance dispute
Provisioning of ICD and real estate advance of Rs 7,422.19 lakh and Rs 2,700 lakh respectively due to recoverability uncertainty
facts.related_party_note: Loans given to related parties include Oswal Corp Limited (Rs 400 lakh) and others as per Note 41. All loans given for business purposes of borrower.
